goal: Extend Task Passports with executor-neutral capability requirements and build deterministic ranked Candidate Execution Plans from Passport requirements and the Agent/Skill Registry without dispatching work.
scope: required and optional capability requirements in Task Passports
deterministic registry matching and ranked compatible source candidates
fail-closed handling for required NOT_PROVEN, unsupported, unavailable, or ambiguous matches
machine-readable Candidate Execution Plan with evidence and claim states
regression coverage constrained by AC-DEV-011 through AC-DEV-016
out_of_scope: moving scheduling, authority, verification, retry, or semantic-success ownership outside Apex
provider/model integration or runtime adapter changes
architecture_constraints: Apex Control Plane owns task semantics, scheduling, capability requirements, and candidate-plan policy
Apex Core owns runtime authority, verification, retry/rework policy, and semantic success
registry sources are ranked candidates only and never dispatch authority
REQUIRED and OPTIONAL requirements remain distinct
NOT_PROVEN, NOT_SUPPORTED, UNKNOWN, PARTIAL, and PROVEN remain distinct
no ECC installation and no permanent executor selection
acceptance_criteria: Task Passport capability requirements support REQUIRED and OPTIONAL entries with minimum claim state
matching produces a deterministic machine-readable Candidate Execution Plan
required NOT_PROVEN or unsupported capabilities fail closed
ambiguous equal-best candidates remain visible and fail closed for REQUIRED requirements
match results preserve observed claim states, source identity, evidence references, and notes
the plan explicitly forbids dispatch and preserves Apex ownership boundaries
validation: dependency and Passport review for AC-DEV-011 through AC-DEV-016
supported, partial, unsupported, ambiguous, and deterministic matcher tests
canonical Python tests and documentation validation
backlog, Passport, and registry JSON validation
git diff --check and protected PR CI gate
